text.title: Bream
text.nearby: Big bronze bream grub along the bottom.
text.about_looks: A tall, flat fish with a small head. Young bream are silvery; old ones turn bronze.
text.about_food: Worms, larvae and snails. It pushes its mouth out like a tube and sucks them from the mud.
text.about_home: Swims in schools near the bottom of lakes, where the bottom is soft mud.
text.about_winter: Rests in deep water under the ice and eats very little.
text.about_young: Spawns in early summer among shallow water plants.
text.about_fact: When bream feed, bubbles and cloudy water rise from the lake bottom.

year.shelter: Rests in deep water in winter, barely moving under the ice.
year.young: Spawns in May–June among shallow water plants.

food.spring: Worms and larvae sucked from the mud.
food.summer: Worms, larvae and snails from the bottom.
food.winter: Eats very little under the ice.
